title: A story's premise is checked when it is planned into a sprint
goal: kb-sprint plan runs each committed story's stated premise (a command in its notes or a 'Premise:' line) before the start gate is asked and records the result, so a story whose premise fails is not committed; a test plants a story whose premise command fails. Answers the SP-tpulmoxh retrospective: ST-4mcoplex was committed and claimed before its premise (a copied index the fingerprint would match) was found false, and was deferred.
